title: Seed pack manifest
description: App-owned contract (ADR 0056) for a seed pack: one manifest plus hashed item files. A pack is the delivery unit for bundled, imported and exported seed data. Items reference the immutable seed_key (never slug/name); codes are attributes; slug is display-only (ADR 0055). This file describes the manifest; item files keep today's per-entity shapes from backend/data/seeds/*.json — each is an envelope: a metadata object plus list collections (items[] for the entity files, units[]/biomarkers[] for default_catalog.json, races[]/ethnicities[]/languages[] for the OMB picklist). Packs are data only: parsed and validated, never executed or imported as code.

schema_version.description: Pack format version the manifest was written for. A newer major than the app supports is a typed validation error, not a silent skip.

license.description: Content license; surfaced in the approval UI. The app validator (backend/app/core/seed_pack.py LICENSE_ALLOWLIST) is authoritative and emits LICENSE_NOT_ALLOWED; this enum must stay in parity with it (pinned by tests/test_seed_pack_schema.py).

scope.description: system packs write canonical (tenant_id NULL) rows; tenant packs write tenant overlays and may only target tenant-ownable types (the entity capability matrix is enforced by the apply engine).

priority.description: Apply precedence, ascending: bundled (0) < curated remote (100) < tenant overlay (200+). The 0-999 range is schema-checked; the scope bands (system packs 0-199, tenant packs 200-999) are cross-field and enforced by the app validator (PRIORITY_SCOPE_MISMATCH), which is authoritative for them; equal priority with different content is a typed conflict at apply time.

min_app_version.description: Minimum app version that understands this pack's content.

description.description: Human-facing summary shown in the approval UI.

replaces.description: seed_keys this pack retires/repoints (rename merge: new UUID, curated edges repointed, patient FKs untouched). Retire only applies where no other active approved source still provides the item.

path.description: Pack-relative path to an item file. No absolute paths, no path traversal, JSON only; binary anatomy figures stay bundled-only in v1. The app validator classifies the hostile forms (absolute/drive/backslash: ITEM_PATH_ABSOLUTE, .. segments: ITEM_PATH_TRAVERSAL, symlink escape at load time: ITEM_PATH_ESCAPE) and is authoritative.

sha256.description: Digest of the item file bytes; the source lane pins versions by digest (UNIQUE(source_id, digest) at the source layer).
